description: FactSet Research Systems Inc. and its wholly-owned subsidiaries was founded in 1978 and has been publicly traded since June 1996, and is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange and the NASDAQ Stock Market under the symbol FDS and has been a member of the S&P 500 since December 2021. It is a global financial digital platform and enterprise solutions provider with open and flexible technologies that deliver financial intelligence to investment professionals worldwide, and its platform delivers expansive data, sophisticated analytics and flexible, artificial intelligence-powered technologies used by global financial professionals to power their critical investment workflows. As of August 31, 2025 it had approximately 9,000 clients comprised of over 237,000 investment professionals, including institutional asset managers, bankers, wealth managers, asset owners, partners, hedge funds, corporate users, and private equity and venture capital professionals. Its CGS business is the exclusive issuer of CUSIP and CINS identifiers globally and acts as the official numbering agency for ISIN identifiers in the U.S.
